name: beejunior-root
description: Monorepo root: npm workspaces (packages/*, api, web) + repo-level tooling. rooms/ and crawler/ keep their own lockfiles.

scripts.lint: eslint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern packages api worker admin rooms crawler scripts
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run deps:check && npm run licenses:check
